bias.label: Leaning down below 4,088 after strong jobs data

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. Market closes for the weekend tonight, so watch for a gap at Monday's open.

bullets.title: Jobs beat big
bullets.text: US payrolls rose 165,000 in October against about 65,000 expected, unemployment fell to 4.1% and wages rose 0.4% (Kitco, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Gold down 1%
bullets.text: Spot gold was 4,047 at 15:46 SAST, down about 1%, after a low of 4,033; Trading Economics later showed about 4,060 (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar rose about 0.7% to its highest since 29 Oct, the dollar index is near 102.2 and the 2-year yield rose to about 4.53%.

bullets.title: Hike odds up
bullets.text: Odds of a December Fed hike rose to roughly 75-77% after the report, but sources differ, so the exact number is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Still a strong week
bullets.text: Gold is still up about 4.5% this week, its best week since late August, so buyers have not left.

bullets.title: Some buying support
bullets.text: Poland's central bank reached its 700-ton gold target and left room for more, and Indian buying picked up before Diwali (ADM).

Wait for Monday's open to settle if price gaps.
watch: Strong jobs data and higher hike odds favour sellers. You are fighting the move.
